_comment: Per-(model, task) Focus speedup vs FP16 dense systolic. Focus runs on a dense FP16 32x32 systolic array @ 500MHz, so energy is auto-derived as mix_simulator_FP16_energy / speedup for apples-to-apples comparison with the mix_simulator baseline. Real Focus simulator energy CSVs are kept in simulator/Focus/simulator/results/main_*.csv if you want raw mJ.
